issue.title: [flora] Persist groundcover-crop condition records through the same model
issue.body:
## Background

Epic #2526, slice EFM-6. #2549 (EFM-5) supplies identity-keyed condition
records for wild and row flora. Groundcover crops are tile-keyed `CropPlot`
values with no instance identity; this issue embeds the same semantic
record in that existing owner and persists it in one implementation PR.
Condition-aware growth, rendering, and harvest refusal belong to #2555
(EFM-7).

Verified against `master` `c3a4cd1331ba` (2026-09-10), before #2549:

- `World.Flora.CropPlot.CropPlotOf s` carries species, planted day, and
  health. `wsCropPlotsRef` owns the canonical tile-keyed map; save capture
  names species into `wpsCropPlots`, and load staging resolves them back.
  The `nameCrop` and `resolveCrop` conversions in `World.Save.Types` change
  only `cpSpecies`. `cropPlotInstance` uses `floraInstanceIdNone` solely as
  a growth adapter.
- `world-activity` is currently v6. Its three-field `CropPlotDTO` uses
  `FloraRef`; the older three-field `CropPlotDTOv1` uses a legacy species
  ordinal. #2549 supplies v7 and its occurrence-condition store before
  this issue moves the component to v8.
- `handleWorldDesignatePlantCommand` inserts a `PlantDesignation`.
  `world.plantCropAt` in `Engine.Scripting.Lua.API.Forage.Crop` performs the
  actual `newCropPlot` insertion on eligible tilled soil without an
  existing plot or flora instance.
- A bare `world.harvestFlora` derives plot eligibility from `floraGrowth`
  and `harvestOpen`; a successful harvest spawns yields and deletes the
  entire plot. Growth-derived dead plots are not harvest-open. These
  functions currently consume no persistent condition record.
- `world.getCropPlotAt` reports growth-derived `id`, `age`, `health`, and
  `phase`; it does not expose a condition.

## Requirements

1. A `CropPlot` carries an optional condition value using the exact shared
   value type from #2549. It contains condition, cause, begin day, render
   context (always `cultivated`), frozen life phase and annual stage, and
   the snapshotted retention outcome. The condition contains no texture
   handle, path, or runtime `FloraId` ordinal. Keep plot ownership
   tile-keyed and page-scoped; never put `floraInstanceIdNone` into the
   identity-keyed store. Newly planted plots start without a condition.
2. Pure operations mark a plot dead with a caller-supplied outcome, clear
   its condition, and read it. Marking an already conditioned plot is
   refused and preserves every original condition field and all other
   plot fields. Clearing removes only the condition; clearing an
   unconditioned plot leaves it unchanged. Reads return the stored value
   or its absence. One page-qualified Haskell query supports both a
   row-flora identity and a canonical plot tile, returning the shared
   record type for #2555 to expose later.
3. The condition follows the plot through capture, encode/decode, species
   reference conversion, and load staging without losing or recomputing
   any field. Deleting the plot, including through an existing successful
   harvest, discards its condition. Replanting on the emptied tile creates
   a fresh unconditioned plot. Planting over an existing plot remains
   refused regardless of its condition. Add no expiry sweep, cleanup
   action, or automatic `await_replanting` transition; EFM-10 owns those.
4. `world-activity` moves from #2549's v7 to v8. Freeze the outgoing v7
   page and crop DTO layouts verbatim, append the optional condition to
   the current crop DTO, and migrate old crops with no condition. Every
   retained decoder must transitively retain its historical crop layout:
   v6 and v7 use the frozen three-field `FloraRef` crop shape; earlier
   retained formats keep their original legacy species representation and
   existing migrations. Freezing a page wrapper must not leave its nested
   crop type pointing at the new four-field DTO. Preserve species
   references, planted day, health, and unrelated page state throughout
   migration. Generate and register a current v8 complete-session fixture
   and baseline through `tools/save_compat_audit.py --generate-session`.
5. Component-boundary validation refuses a crop condition whose expiry
   day precedes its begin day, whose context is not `cultivated`, or whose
   stage or cause is outside the shared vocabulary. Diagnostics name the
   page and canonical tile. Apply the existing persistence rules for
   semantic records and durable species references.
6. Update `docs/persistence_state_inventory.md`'s `wpsCropPlots` and
   `wsCropPlotsRef` rows with the embedded condition and discard-on-delete
   rule. Update the identity section of
   `docs/flora_visual_state_contract.md` to describe plot-value ownership,
   and list the new gates in `docs/engine_contracts.md` section Flora
   visual state and fallback. Required documentation, fixtures, and
   validation evidence belong in this same implementation PR and are
   complete before final review and merge.
7. This slice is persistence-only. Storing a `dead` condition does not yet
   alter growth, freeze the running growth state, change rendering, close
   a harvest window, change planting eligibility, or add Lua fields or
   verbs. An otherwise harvest-open plot carrying a condition remains
   harvestable through the existing path; its successful harvest deletes
   both plot and condition. A plot whose existing growth-derived state is
   dead continues to return `nil` from `world.harvestFlora`. #2555 owns
   integrating conditions into growth and condition-based harvest refusal.
   Wild and row-flora behavior stays as supplied by #2549.

## Acceptance

```bash
cabal build all
cabal build synarchy-test-headless
cabal test synarchy-test-headless --test-options='--match "crop plot condition persistence"'
cabal test synarchy-test-headless --test-options='--match "flora condition persistence"'
cabal test synarchy-test-headless --test-options='--match "save migrations"'
cabal test synarchy-test-headless --test-options='--match "Save.Snapshot"'
```

Expected: the build and every named group pass with nonzero example counts.
The new `crop plot condition persistence` group exercises production
operations and persistence paths, covering:

- Mark a planted groundcover plot, capture it, encode/decode it, and stage
  it again. The same page and tile retain every condition field, planted
  day, health, and correctly resolved species reference.
- Read before and after marking; refuse a second mark carrying different
  cause, day, phase/stage, and outcome; prove the original record and
  remaining plot fields are unchanged. Clear and read absence, then clear
  again and prove the plot remains unchanged.
- The uniform Haskell query returns the same record type for a row-flora
  identity and a plot tile without using the reserved non-identity value.
- With Haskell fixture setup supplying a condition, an otherwise
  harvest-open plot still succeeds through the existing Lua harvest verb,
  and its plot and condition disappear. The existing planting verb then
  creates an unconditioned replacement on that tile. Planting over an
  occupied conditioned plot is refused. A growth-derived dead plot still
  refuses harvesting with `nil`.
- Nonempty v6 and v7 crop payloads decode through the real component
  registry into unconditioned current plots while preserving species,
  planted day, and health. Exercise every earlier retained crop-bearing
  layout too. Include unrelated page data, including a v7 occurrence
  condition, to catch field misalignment and accidental state loss. Use
  historical bytes or frozen legacy DTO encoders; an empty map or bytes
  encoded with the new DTO do not prove legacy compatibility.
- Every validation refusal in requirement 5 identifies the page and tile.

The current complete-session fixture is generated with the production
helper; record its exact invocation and provenance in the PR. The helper
only generates the current format. Legacy v6/v7 payloads use the frozen
formats above. Nonempty crop-condition coverage comes from the focused
Haskell tests and does not require adding a condition-setting Lua API.

```bash
python3 tools/persistence_inventory_audit.py
python3 tools/test_persistence_inventory_audit.py
python3 tools/enum_append_only_audit.py
python3 tools/save_compat_audit.py
python3 tools/test_save_compat_audit.py
python3 tools/unicode_operator_audit.py
python3 tools/haskell_module_budget.py
```

Expected: all gates pass with the v8 fixture registered. The save-compat
self-test includes its reproducibility member because the schema and
fixture inputs changed.

```bash
python3 tools/save_compat_migration_probe.py
python3 tools/persistence_contract_probe.py
python3 tools/run_probes.py --only crop_probe,plant_probe --jobs 1
```

Expected: tracked compatibility sessions load, publish, resave, and reload;
the compact persistence probe passes; crops still plant, grow, harvest, and
persist. Run probes sequentially. No rendering change is included, so
GPU-free behavioral evidence is sufficient for this slice.

## Out of scope

- #2555 (EFM-7): condition-aware growth and harvest refusal, rendering a
  condition, the world-thread mutation seam, and Lua condition inspection.
- EFM-10: expiry, corpse-policy selection, automatic plot removal for
  replanting, and `await_replanting` transitions.
- Crop-specific death balance, cleanup jobs, hazard producers, and art.
- Changes to wild or row-flora storage and behavior beyond consuming
  #2549's shared record and exposing the common Haskell query.

## Related

- Epic #2526 (EFM-6), phase 2, critical path. Depends on #2549 for the
  shared record and v7 component. #2555 (EFM-7) is blocked by this issue.
- #334 (closed): groundcover `CropPlot` and one-shot harvest.
- #2243 (closed): durable `FloraRef` species references in crop DTOs.
- `docs/persistence_contract.md` section 5 and
  `src/World/Save/CLAUDE.md`: retained wire formats and migration gates.
- Design record: `docs/environmental_flora_mortality_design.md` (D-4
  through D-6, D-10, D-12 through D-14, D-19); supporting pointer, not
  required context.

## Automated cross-agent issue review

Reviewed against `master@c3a4cd1331ba` by GPT-6-Astra (`gpt-6-astra` at `high`).

**Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED**

Corrections and spec additions below amend the implementation spec. Supporting context is non-normative. Open decisions remain unresolved and must not be guessed.

### Corrections
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Correct the Background’s planting attribution: handleWorldDesignatePlantCommand inserts a PlantDesignation, not a CropPlot (src/World/Thread/Command/Cursor/Plant.hs:103). The actual newCropPlot insertion occurs in world.plantCropAt (src/Engine/Scripting/Lua/API/Forage/Crop.hs:115).

### Spec additions / clarifications
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Exercise clear/read behavior and prove that a refused second mark preserves every original condition field. Requirement 2 promises these pure operations, but Acceptance currently covers only successful marking and double-mark refusal.
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Include nonempty legacy crop payloads in migration coverage, especially v6 and v7. Every retained decoder must use the frozen three-field crop shape wherever applicable; freezing only the outgoing page wrapper is insufficient. Grounding: src/World/Save/Component/PageActivity.hs:383 and docs/engine_contracts.md §Enum append-only audit require preservation of nested historical wire layouts.

### Supporting context
- **GPT-6-Astra:** The checked-out HEAD matches dossier base c3a4cd1331baa2f9910f3e3844f8f7ff1e58b65a. CropPlot currently contains species, planted day, and health; cropPlotInstance uses floraInstanceIdNone (src/World/Flora/CropPlot.hs:54,106), supporting embedded ownership rather than an occurrence-identity entry.
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Species conversion updates only cpSpecies during capture and restoration, allowing an embedded semantic record to survive both conversions without persisting a runtime species ordinal (src/World/Save/Types.hs, nameCrop and resolveCrop).
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Existing harvesting deletes the entire plot, and planting refuses any occupied plot tile, supporting discard-on-delete and fresh replacement semantics (src/Engine/Scripting/Lua/API/Forage/Harvest.hs:128 and src/Engine/Scripting/Lua/API/Forage/Crop.hs:99).

### Open decisions
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Decide whether a condition-marked crop that otherwise has an open growth-based harvest window remains harvestable until EFM-7 or must immediately refuse harvesting. Requirement 7 promises nil while excluding growth, harvest-window, and Lua changes, but worldHarvestFloraFn derives eligibility solely from floraGrowth and harvestOpen (src/Engine/Scripting/Lua/API/Forage/Harvest.hs:102–110); those functions do not consume a condition record (src/World/Flora/Growth.hs:118,187). The acceptance scenario that harvests an open conditioned plot also depends on this choice.

### Recommended disposition
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Resolve requirement 7 and its acceptance scenario together. To preserve EFM-6’s stated persistence-only scope, explicitly defer condition-based harvest refusal to EFM-7 and qualify the existing nil guarantee as applying to growth-derived dead states. If immediate refusal is intended, authorize the necessary condition-aware eligibility integration and adjust the deletion/replanting test accordingly. Grounding: requirement 7, Acceptance, and src/Engine/Scripting/Lua/API/Forage/Harvest.hs:102–128.

### Reviewer summaries
- **GPT-6-Astra — CHANGES REQUESTED:** The persistence scope is sound, assuming #2549 lands as specified, but requirement 7 leaves a behavioral contradiction requiring an owner decision: recording death alone cannot make an otherwise harvestable crop return nil while growth and harvest behavior remain unchanged.

## Automated cross-agent issue rereview

Reviewed against `master@c3a4cd1331ba` by Claude Fable 5.1 (`claude-fable-5-1` at `high`).

**Verdict: APPROVE**

Corrections and spec additions below amend the implementation spec. Supporting context is non-normative. Open decisions remain unresolved and must not be guessed.

### Corrections
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** Requirement 1 lists the record's fields without the expiry day that requirement 5 validates. Read requirement 1 as: the plot carries exactly #2549's shared condition type, including whatever expiry-day field its retention outcome carries; add no crop-specific fields. Grounding: requirement 5 ("expiry day precedes its begin day") and docs/environmental_flora_mortality_design.md:404 ("the selected corpse-retention outcome and any expiry day").
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** Requirement 2's uniform query should accept any #2549 occurrence identity (wild or row), not only a row-flora identity, since #2549's store is keyed by occurrence identity and this issue must not narrow it; the acceptance bullet may use a row identity as its instance. Grounding: design doc EFM-5 (docs/environmental_flora_mortality_design.md:888-892) covers wild and row occurrences in one store.

### Spec additions / clarifications
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** Bump `currentSaveVersion` (src/World/Save/Types.hs:152, currently 102) in the same PR: `WorldPageSave.wpsCropPlots` is `SavedCropPlots` = `CropPlotOf FloraRef` (src/World/Save/Types.hs:447, src/World/Flora/CropPlot.hs:73), and that record is encoded positionally by its Generic instance with the documented rule that any layout change bumps the marker (src/World/Save/Types.hs:300). This is bookkeeping, not an on-disk compatibility gate; the v7→v8 component migration remains the real compatibility mechanism.
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** Requirement 5 vocabulary clause: if #2549 represents cause and stage as closed Haskell enums, an out-of-vocabulary value is unrepresentable after decode and is refused by the decoder rather than by component validation. In that case the clause is discharged by the decode refusal, the page-and-tile diagnostic requirement applies to the reachable refusals (expiry before begin day, context other than `cultivated`), and the acceptance test must not fabricate an unreachable validation case. If #2549 stores them as open tags, validate them as written. Grounding: src/World/Save/CLAUDE.md §Enum schema policy (positional constructor tags) and validateWorldActivity's page-naming precedent at src/World/Save/Component/PageActivity.hs:967-985.
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** Diagnostics in requirement 5 name the tile as stored in the v8 payload key. Validation runs before applyWorldActivity's canonicalization (src/World/Save/Component/PageActivity.hs:1066-1079), and v2+ payloads already promise canonical keys (PageActivity.hs:989-999), so no re-canonicalization is required inside validation.
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** Documentation targets: `docs/flora_visual_state_contract.md` and the engine-contracts section "Flora visual state and fallback" do not exist at master@​c3a4cd1 (no match under docs/); they are EFM-1 (#2530) deliverables reached transitively through #2549's dependency chain (docs/environmental_flora_mortality_design.md:20-24). If the landed file or section names differ, update the identity/ownership section EFM-1 and #2549 actually created and state the mapping in the PR; do not create a parallel document.
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** Requirement 4 clarification for the frozen wrappers: after this PR, #2549's frozen v6 page wrapper and the new frozen v7 page wrapper must both nest a frozen three-field `FloraRef` crop DTO, while the existing v2-v5 wrappers keep nesting `CropPlotDTOv1` (src/World/Save/Component/PageActivity.hs:741,766,792,816) and their migrations (:404-406, :908) stay unchanged. Only the current `CropPlotDTO` referenced by the v8 page DTO (:702) gains the appended optional field.

### Supporting context
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** Checked-out HEAD matches dossier base c3a4cd1331baa2f9910f3e3844f8f7ff1e58b65a; `world-activity` is v6 (src/World/Save/Component/PageActivity.hs:1023) with older versions 1-5 registered (:1029-1033).
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** Prior open decision resolved: Harvest.hs derives plot eligibility from floraGrowth/harvestOpen (:101-112), deletes the plot on success (:128-129), and returns Nothing for an ineligible existing plot (:132). Requirement 7 and the acceptance scenario now match this behavior exactly, deferring condition-based refusal to #2555.
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** Background correction applied: src/World/Thread/Command/Cursor/Plant.hs reads plots only (:71); the `newCropPlot` insertion is in src/Engine/Scripting/Lua/API/Forage/Crop.hs:115-117, which refuses on an existing plot or flora instance (:99-103). Row-crop planting also refuses on an existing plot (src/World/Thread/Command/Edit/Vegetation.hs:141-157), so "planting over an existing plot remains refused regardless of condition" holds for both verbs by construction.
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** Discard-on-delete holds by construction if the condition is embedded in the plot value: the only plot removals are the harvest delete (Harvest.hs:128) and whole-map replacement at load (src/World/Load/Stage.hs:744).
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** Species conversions change only `cpSpecies` (src/World/Save/Types.hs:1630 nameCrop, :1691 resolveCrop), and `missingFloraReferences` already walks crop plots (:1539-1541), so an embedded record survives both conversions and existing durable-reference validation applies unchanged.
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** Current frozen shapes: `CropPlotDTO` is three fields with `FloraRef` (PageActivity.hs:383-387); `CropPlotDTOv1` uses `FloraId` migrated to `FloraByLegacyId` (:391-406); the live `CropPlotOf s` is species, planted day, health (src/World/Flora/CropPlot.hs:54-65) and `cropPlotInstance` uses `floraInstanceIdNone` as a growth adapter only (:106-120).
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** Acceptance surface exists: hspec groups "save migrations" (test-headless/Spec.hs:859) and "Save.Snapshot" (:878); "flora condition persistence" is assumed from #2549; crop and plant probes are registered (tools/probe_runner_registry.py:95, :188); `--generate-session` exists (tools/save_compat_audit.py:213); every named tool under tools/ exists.
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** The design record's EFM-6 entry (docs/environmental_flora_mortality_design.md:905-918) matches this issue's scope and the embed-in-CropPlot ownership choice it settles (:409-415). The `[x]` markers in that doc's processing status are filing markers, not evidence that any slice has landed.
- **Claude Fable 5.1:** GitHub issue reads were denied in this session, so #2549's body was not inspected; it is treated as an assumed contract per the dependency policy.

### Reviewer summaries
- **Claude Fable 5.1 — APPROVE:** The revision resolves the prior open decision: requirement 7 and its acceptance scenario now agree that a conditioned but harvest-open plot stays harvestable through the existing verb and that `nil` applies only to growth-derived dead plots, matching src/Engine/Scripting/Lua/API/Forage/Harvest.hs:92-133. The earlier corrections (planting attribution, clear/read coverage, nonempty v6/v7 legacy payloads with frozen nested crop layouts) are incorporated. Independently checking the full spec against master@​c3a4cd1 confirms the premise (v6 component, three-field FloraRef crop DTO, tile-keyed plots, species-only capture/restore conversions, delete-on-harvest, refuse-on-occupied planting). Remaining gaps are resolvable by amendment: bump `currentSaveVersion` for the `WorldPageSave` layout change, treat the record as exactly #2549's type including its expiry field, handle the vocabulary-validation clause honestly if #2549 uses closed enums, and map the documentation targets to what EFM-1/#2549 actually created.
